The hamster is facing forward with its front paws visible, resting on the edge of the green object. There is illegible, gibberish text written in black marker on the green plastic surface in the foreground.

The ears are visible on top of the head, appearing rounded and proportionate to the head size.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is black writing on the green object that resembles handwriting but forms no coherent words or characters. This is a classic AI artifact where the model attempts to replicate text-like patterns without understanding orthography.

artifact_observations.location: Interface between hamster fur and green plastic
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and blending at the edges where the fur meets the hard plastic surface, suggesting minor generation blur or edge bleeding.
